name: trains-on-map
description: Live train positions, delays, station boards and service alerts for 12 countries.

interface.longDescription: Live answers about passenger trains in 12 countries: where a train is now, how late it is, which stops it has left, what is leaving a station and from which platform, service alerts, and how punctual a train has been. Every answer carries a link to the same train or station on the live map. Read-only and account-free: it cannot book, cancel or pay for a ticket. Data handling: https://trainsonmap.com/privacy
